description: BIA Edge helps users research U.S. immigration law in ChatGPT by retrieving case law, statutes and regulations, agency policy, unpublished decisions, validity and citation treatment, visa bulletins, EOIR statistics, doctrine data, and criminal-code text. Its 42 tools are read-only and return source-grounded records and warnings for the model to evaluate. It does not provide legal advice.
